# Rōmy

> Rōmy helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of existing solutions.

Rōmy is a donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit teams. It uses AI-powered prospect research to surface wealth indicators, giving histories, and affinity signals — then distills them into actionable donor profiles.

## Features

- Donor Discovery: AI-powered prospect research with wealth indicators, giving history, and affinity signals
- Fraction of the Cost: No enterprise contracts or per-seat licensing — donor intelligence at a price built for small nonprofits
- Ready to Act On: Every prospect comes with connection points, giving capacity, and outreach angles

## Writing

Rōmy publishes research, engineering write-ups, and industry analysis on nonprofit fundraising, prospect research, and donor intelligence at https://getromy.app/blog. Key posts:

- Major Gifts Aren't a Wealth Problem. They're a Timing Problem. — https://getromy.app/blog/major-gifts-are-a-timing-problem
- The Small Nonprofit Fundraising Gap — and How to Close It — https://getromy.app/blog/small-nonprofit-fundraising-gap
- Capacity Scores Are the Astrology of Fundraising — https://getromy.app/blog/capacity-scores-are-the-astrology-of-fundraising
- What Actually Predicts Giving Capacity — and How Rōmy Scores It — https://getromy.app/blog/understanding-wealth-indicators
- Most Boards Are Alumni of Indifference — https://getromy.app/blog/most-boards-are-alumni-of-indifference
- Nobody Reads Your Annual Report — https://getromy.app/blog/nobody-reads-your-annual-report
- The Gala Is the Worst Place to Meet a Donor — https://getromy.app/blog/the-gala-is-the-worst-place
- You Don't Have Donors. You Have Neighbors. — https://getromy.app/blog/you-dont-have-donors-you-have-neighbors
- How We Built a Donor Intelligence Engine Starting at $0.10 per Prospect — https://getromy.app/blog/how-we-built-donor-intelligence

The blog also carries an ongoing "Field Notes" series — short narrative essays on the human, day-to-day realities of major gift fundraising, donor stewardship, and planned giving — indexed at https://getromy.app/blog.

## Research

PIF-Bench, Rōmy's open benchmark comparing AI-powered donor prospect research systems (Rōmy, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) on accuracy, cost, and speed, is published at https://getromy.app/labs.

## Company

GetRomy LLC — a donor intelligence company based in Kerrville, Texas.
